mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: IHFC, IIT Delhi, has expertise in AI, robotics, cyber-physical systems and autonomous technology.
Statement B: AMTZ has nurtured more than 100 healthcare start-ups.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. IHFC is associated with AI, robotics, cyber-physical systems and autonomous technology, while AMTZ has nurtured more than 100 healthcare start-ups. The other options incorrectly reject one or both of these facts.

mcqs.question: What was the theme of the 5th BRICS Working Group meeting on Geospatial Technologies and its Applications held at IIT-Tirupati?
options: Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
Building for Technology, Industry, Cooperation and Security
Building for Resilience, Infrastructure, Commerce and Sustainability
Building for Innovation, Cooperation, Technology and Development
mcqs.explanation: The theme was “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.” The other options alter one or more elements of the official theme.

mcqs.question: Which option correctly identifies the countries that participated virtually in the 5th BRICS Working Group meeting on Geospatial Technologies and its Applications?
options: Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa and UAE
Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa and UAE, with Brazil repeated
Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, UAE and South Africa, with Egypt repeated
Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa and China, with UAE omitted
mcqs.explanation: The virtual participants were Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa and the UAE. The other options repeat one country and thereby omit another country from the participant list.

mcqs.question:
Match the overseas markets of Andhra Pradesh mangoes with the reported 2025–26 trend.

List-I
(a) UK
(b) Nepal
(c) USA

List-II
(i) Value increased from ₹76.09 crore to ₹89.31 crore
(ii) Value nearly doubled from ₹9.15 crore to ₹18.71 crore, with an additional 5,772 MT
(iii) Value fell from ₹95 crore to ₹82 crore owing to tariffs
(iv) Value was ₹144.41 crore and the market was the top importer
options: a-i, b-ii, c-iii
a-ii, b-iii, c-i
a-iii, b-i, c-ii
a-i, b-iii, c-iv
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are UK–i, Nepal–ii and USA–iii. The UK value rose from ₹76.09 crore to ₹89.31 crore; Nepal’s value rose from ₹9.15 crore to ₹18.71 crore with an additional 5,772 MT; and the USA value fell from ₹95 crore to ₹82 crore owing to tariffs. The tempting alternative involving ₹144.41 crore refers to the UAE, not the UK, Nepal or USA trend tested here.

mcqs.question: Where is the headquarters of APEDA, the statutory body under the APEDA Act, 1985?
options: New Delhi
Mumbai
Vijayawada
Guntur
mcqs.explanation: APEDA’s headquarters is in New Delhi. Mumbai is a tempting trap, but the headquarters is not in Mumbai; Vijayawada and Guntur are also incorrect.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: APTDC also plans tourism investment through the PPP model, caravan, beach and experiential tourism, and better food at APTDC hotels.
Statement B: The APTDC board meeting was held aboard a caravan travelling from Vijayawada to Suryalanka Beach near Bapatla.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The tourism plan includes PPP investment, caravan, beach and experiential tourism, and improved food at APTDC hotels; the board meeting took place aboard a caravan travelling from Vijayawada to Suryalanka Beach near Bapatla. The other options incorrectly change the status of one or both statements.

mcqs.question:
Match the Craft Wood Bank beneficiary centres with their traditional crafts.

List-I
(a) Kondapalli
(b) Etikoppaka
(c) Bobbili
(d) Udayagiri

List-II
(i) Veena
(ii) Wooden cutlery
(iii) Wooden toys
(iv) Lacquer toys
options: a-iii, b-iv, c-i, d-ii
a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i
a-iii, b-i, c-iv, d-ii
a-ii, b-iv, c-i, d-iii
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Kondapalli–wooden toys, Etikoppaka–lacquer toys, Bobbili–Veena and Udayagiri–wooden cutlery. The other codes interchange the traditional crafts associated with these centres.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The prices of wood supplied through the Craft Wood Banks are set by a committee led by the PCCF.
Reason (R): The National Mission on Handicrafts is under the Ministry of Textiles.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Assertion and the Reason are true. Prices are set by a committee led by the PCCF, while the National Mission on Handicrafts is under the Ministry of Textiles; the ministry association does not explain the committee’s pricing authority. Therefore, the second option is correct.

mcqs.question: The Undavalli Caves, associated with the Telugu Mahotsavam, belong to which period and are located beside which river?
options: 4th–5th century AD; Krishna River
420–620 AD; Godavari River
4th–5th century AD; Penna River
Gupta period; Tungabhadra River
mcqs.explanation: The Undavalli Caves are 4th–5th century AD rock-cut sandstone caves on a hill beside the Krishna River. The other options substitute the river or combine the stated period with an incorrect river.

mcqs.question:
Match the rock-cut cave site with the associated description or location.

List-I
(a) Undavalli Caves
(b) Ajanta
(c) Badami
(d) Udayagiri

List-II
(i) Maharashtra
(ii) Karnataka
(iii) Madhya Pradesh
(iv) Originally a Buddhist vihara

Choose the correct code:
options: a-iv, b-i, c-ii, d-iii
a-i, b-iv, c-iii, d-ii
a-iv, b-ii, c-i, d-iii
a-iii, b-i, c-ii, d-iv
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Undavalli–originally a Buddhist vihara, Ajanta–Maharashtra, Badami–Karnataka and Udayagiri–Madhya Pradesh. The other codes assign the locations or the Buddhist-vihara description to the wrong cave site.
